purpose: Exhaustive final S11 native-atlas coverage with no main-example selection and no duplicated physical reference census.

required_contexts.source: Canonical sigma1 E2-augmented E0 plus genuinely new E3 sizes, with all matched-mean and zero controls.
required_contexts.precedence: Prefer verified dense companions only after exact scalar/source identity is established. Canonical normalization fixes observation and realization IDs before feature selection.
required_contexts.exact_count_authority: Final normalized canonical inventory, frozen before selection.

required_contexts.source: Only sigma0.25,0.5,2 extra forcing arms, each24 conditions with12 stochastic realizations.
required_contexts.references: Sigma1, sigma0 and deterministic-control references point to canonical common IDs/pages; they are not duplicated physical reference pages.

required_contexts.source: Full-long52 noisy conditions, all12 realizations each, plus52 matched means and12 zero controls; kept separate from common.
required_contexts.horizons: Use actual source horizons; no relabeling/truncation or pooling with common.

excluded_as_additional_mandatory_context.E0v2: Preserved qualified prototype and reusable provenance crosswalk; no extra mandatory final census.
excluded_as_additional_mandatory_context.longest: A selector/reference view of common and E4_long, not a third duplicate independent census.

context_and_origin: Group by the declared atlas_context, never by raw origin stage. Preserve original experiment/stage, source observation ID and source/native file hashes separately in every case and page.
selection_ID: Use the canonical independent-realization ID as the stable physical case ID for medoid ties and deterministic-random hashes; source observation/companion IDs remain provenance, not new seed identities.
selection_rules: Retain the seven predeclared last-half native scalar features, time weights, IQR/nonzero-range scaling, stable1e-12 score ties and master SHA256 seed2026102011. Compute physical feature differences before dividing by scale to avoid subtracting large normalized means.
reuse_and_counts: Observation companions, replay aliases and longer observations retain their explicit reuse/independence mapping. Count unique canonical realization IDs globally; report per-context native observation counts separately. Deterministic controls contribute no stochastic independent seeds or bootstrap replicates.
snapshots: Native samples nearest0,0.5,0.75,1 horizon, exact ties earlier. Print actual saved times; retain every native field frame and actual physical circumference. No source-field interpolation/resampling/quantization.
numerical_exports: Per-page full time/actualC/all-active-cell CSV.gz with17-significant-digit float64 roundtrip proof; q grids, complete native snapshots and every plotted scalar curve in companion CSVs. Full fields remain verified HPC archives, with tracked inventory/hash/path/rows/grid metadata; compact reader must not link absent GitHub archives.

master_contract.page_data_indices: One entry per required atlas index: exact path,sha256,pages,atlas_context plus every source volume/page/CSV-shard mapping.
master_contract.completeness: False until all frozen required contexts and every actual required page/volume/shard are present and gated. Do not infer required contexts from whichever outputs finish. Exact inventory counts are normalized and frozen before selection, never chosen from outcomes.

source_inventory_binding: Pending accepted canonical inventories and native/strict gates. Bind exact inventories, alias mappings and required case IDs in a versioned preselection receipt before loading future selection features.
